heading: Actuation Model (Current)
text:
-**joints** use position actuators intended to represent the **GX G25 coreless servos** (stall torque ≈ 25 kg·cm @ 7.4V; torque-limited in simulation).

See `docs/servo-info.md` for the numbers used.
